memories.title: Rajasthan — Desert Majesty
memories.caption: Roamed the pink corridors of Hawa Mahal, walked along the massive battlements of Amer Fort at dusk, and savored steaming Pyaaz Kachoris while watching the desert sun sink beneath the horizon.

memories.title: Himachal Pradesh — High Valleys
memories.caption: Waking up in Spiti and Manali surrounded by crisp pine-scented mountain air, winding Himalayan highways, high-altitude cedar forests, and freezing fresh river streams.

memories.title: Delhi NCR — Living History
memories.caption: Evening breeze at India Gate, soulful Qawwalis echoing through Nizamuddin Dargah, and late-night culinary expeditions through the labyrinth alleyways of Old Delhi.

memories.title: Bihar — Ancient Wisdom
memories.caption: Quiet contemplation beneath the Mahabodhi Tree in Bodh Gaya, tracing ancient history across the ruins of Nalanda University, and traditional authentic Litti Chokha over wood fires.

memories.title: Goa — Coastal Sunset
memories.caption: Renting a scooter along the palm-fringed coastal backroads of South Goa, watching dramatic Arabian Sea sunsets, and discovering quiet Portuguese architecture in Fontainhas.

memories.title: Kerala — God's Own Country
memories.caption: Drifting gently through misty Alleppey backwaters on a wooden houseboat, walking across emerald tea plantations in Munnar, and tasting fresh traditional appams with stew.

memories.title: Ladakh — The Land of High Passes
memories.caption: Crossing Khardung La Pass at 17,982 ft, watching azure reflections across the sacred waters of Pangong Tso, and gazing at prayer flags fluttering outside ancient Thiksey Monastery.
